title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 3,751–3,800 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 航空公司；航空載具；運送業者

examples.en: EVA Air and China Airlines are Taiwan's premier international flagship carriers.
examples.zh: 長榮航空與中華航空是代表台灣飛往全球各大航點的頂級國際旗艦航空公司。

examples.en: Low-cost carriers offer budget-friendly fares by charging extra for checked bags and meals.
examples.zh: 廉價低成本航空公司透過將託運行李與機上餐點列為加購項目，提供極具競爭力的親民票價。

examples.en: The shipping carrier delivered the fragile package safely within twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 這家國際物流貨運承運商在短短二十四小時之內，將易碎的精密包裹完好無損地安全送達。

words.definition: 機場航廈；客運總站；末端的

examples.en: Taoyuan International Airport is constructing a state-of-the-art Terminal 3.
examples.zh: 桃園國際機場目前正全力興建具備智慧綠能建築特色的現代化第三航廈。

examples.en: Take the free airport skytrain to transfer between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2.
examples.zh: 旅客可免費搭乘機場航廈電車（Skytrain），在第一航廈與第二航廈之間快速穿梭往返。

examples.en: The long-distance coach terminal is located directly next to the central railway station.
examples.zh: 國道長途客運轉運總站就坐落在市中心中央火車站的正旁邊，轉乘高鐵火車十分便捷。

words.definition: 報到櫃檯；櫃檯；反駁

examples.en: Passengers queued politely at the airline check-in counter to drop baggage.
examples.zh: 準備出國的旅客在航空公司劃位報到櫃檯前井然有序排隊，辦理託運行李手續。

examples.en: The customer service counter is on the ground floor next to the information desk.
examples.zh: 客服諮詢服務櫃檯位於一樓大廳，緊鄰旅客服務中心服務台。

examples.en: He leaned against the kitchen counter while sipping his freshly brewed morning coffee.
examples.zh: 他一邊放鬆地靠在廚房流理台料理吧檯邊，一邊細細品味剛沖泡好的熱咖啡。

words.definition: 機場登機證（紙本或電子）

examples.en: Save your digital mobile boarding pass to your smartphone wallet app.
examples.zh: 建議在完成線上預辦登機後，將電子登機證直接加入手機錢包 App 方便感應掃描。

examples.en: Make sure you don't lose your paper boarding pass after clearing airport security.
examples.zh: 通過機場出境安全檢查通道後，請務必妥善保管好印有登機門資訊的紙本登機證。

examples.en: The gate attendant scanned her mobile boarding pass before welcoming her aboard.
examples.zh: 登機門地勤人員用手持掃描器感應掃描了她的手機電子登機證條碼，親切引導她步入空橋。

words.definition: 晶片護照；國際旅行證件

examples.en: Ensure your biometric passport has at least six months of remaining validity.
examples.zh: 出國前請務必仔細檢查晶片護照有效期限是否至少仍有六個月以上，以免遭拒絕登機。

examples.en: Keep your passport and cash securely stored inside a zippered neck pouch while traveling.
examples.zh: 出國自助旅行期間，請將個人護照與外幣現鈔妥善存放在貼身的防盜隱形頸包內。

examples.en: She proudly showed the colorful border stamps covering the pages of her travel passport.
examples.zh: 她興奮地向好友展示護照內頁蓋得滿滿當當、記錄著造訪世界各國足跡的彩色出入境戳印。

words.definition: 免簽證的；享有免簽待遇的

examples.en: Taiwan passport holders enjoy generous visa-free entry access to over 140 destinations.
examples.zh: 持中華民國晶片護照享有前往全球超過一百四十個國家與地區的免簽證入境待遇。

examples.en: Traveling to Japan is seamless because Taiwanese tourists can enter visa-free for ninety days.
examples.zh: 台灣民眾前往日本自由行極為便捷，可享有長達九十天免簽證觀光入境待遇。

examples.en: Make sure to check local immigration rules even when traveling under a visa-free agreement.
examples.zh: 即使是在享有免簽互惠待遇的國家旅行，啟程前仍應詳閱當地移民局對入境目的與天數的最新規範。

words.definition: 免費行李額度；零用錢；津貼

examples.en: The economy ticket includes a standard checked baggage allowance of 23 kilograms.
examples.zh: 該經濟艙機票內含一件重量上限為二十三公斤的標準免費託運行李額度。

examples.en: Parents gave their teenage daughter a modest weekly allowance to teach financial discipline.
examples.zh: 父母每週給予青春期女兒一筆適度的每週零用錢，藉此從小培養她自主記帳與理性理財觀念。

examples.en: Premium passengers enjoy a generous baggage allowance of two 32-kilogram bags.
examples.zh: 搭乘商務艙的尊榮旅客享有極為寬裕的免費行李額度，可免費託運兩件各三十二公斤的行李。

words.definition: 隨身登機手提行李；手提的

examples.en: Place your lightweight carry-on rolling suitcase inside the overhead compartment.
examples.zh: 請將符合尺寸規定的輕量隨身登機手提行李箱平穩放置於頭頂上方的行李艙中。

examples.en: Check airline dimensions carefully to ensure your backpack qualifies as a free carry-on.
examples.zh: 出發前請先詳閱各航空公司的隨身行李長寬高規定，確保雙肩背包符合免費手提登機標準。

examples.en: Always keep vital medicines and expensive laptops in your carry-on luggage.
examples.zh: 個人必備的救命處方藥物與昂貴貴重筆電，切記隨時放在手提行李隨身攜帶，嚴禁託運。

words.definition: 金屬探測門；探測器；偵測儀

examples.en: Remove belts and metal coins before walking through the security walk-through detector.
examples.zh: 走過機場出境安全檢查金屬探測門之前，請先主動卸下皮帶手錶並掏出零錢口袋雜物。

examples.en: A handheld metal detector beeped as the officer screened the passenger's jacket pocket.
examples.zh: 當安檢人員使用手持金屬探測儀掃描到外套口袋時，儀器隨即發出清脆的嗶嗶警示聲。

examples.en: Installing a smoke detector in every bedroom is required by modern residential fire codes.
examples.zh: 依據現代住宅消防安全法規，每個獨立臥室天花板皆必須依法安裝獨立式住警器煙霧偵測器。

words.definition: X 光行李掃描儀；掃描機

examples.en: Security officers inspect laptops and electronics via advanced CT baggage scanners.
examples.zh: 機場安檢人員透過先進的斷層掃描 3D X 光機精準透視檢查背包內的筆電與電子產品。

examples.en: The office multifunction printer includes a high-speed flatbed scanner for digitizing documents.
examples.zh: 辦公室的多功能事務印表機配備了高速平台掃描器，能快速將紙本文件批量掃描為數位檔案。

examples.en: Modern 3D body scanners quickly detect concealed prohibited items without invasive physical contact.
examples.zh: 現代全身 3D 人體毫米波掃描儀能在不需肢體接觸的前提下，精準偵測旅客身上夾帶的違禁品。

words.definition: 攜帶限制；管制規定；限制

examples.en: Aviation liquid restrictions mandate all gels be packed in 100ml transparent bottles.
examples.zh: 民航安全法規嚴格規定，隨身攜帶之液體與凝膠乳液每瓶容量不得超過一百毫升。

examples.en: The city imposed traffic speed restrictions in school zones to protect crossing children.
examples.zh: 市政府在各國民小學校園周邊限速學區劃設嚴格的速限交通管制規定，以保護學童過馬路安全。

examples.en: Be aware of import restrictions regarding dried meats, fresh fruits, and dairy products.
examples.zh: 旅客入境前請務必熟記海關對肉乾零食、新鮮生果與乳製品等動植物產品的嚴格輸入限制。

words.definition: 嚴格禁止的；列為違禁品的

examples.en: Carrying compressed gas sprays and sharp pocket knives onto aircraft is strictly prohibited.
examples.zh: 隨身或託運攜帶高壓壓縮噴霧罐與尖銳瑞士刀登機，皆屬於民航法明令禁止之違法行為。

examples.en: Smoking and vaping are strictly prohibited anywhere inside international airport buildings.
examples.zh: 國際機場航廈大廳、登機門與洗手間全區全面嚴禁吸菸與抽電子煙，違者將面臨重罰。

examples.en: Entering the restricted construction zone without wearing a hard safety helmet is prohibited.
examples.zh: 嚴禁任何人員在未正確配戴工業安全帽的情況下，擅自跨越警示線踏入管制施工工區。

words.definition: 鋰；鋰電池 (Lithium Battery)

examples.en: Spare portable lithium power banks must be kept in carry-on bags, never checked.
examples.zh: 所有隨身備用行動電源與鋰電池必須一律放在手提行李隨身攜帶，嚴禁放入託運行李。

examples.en: Rechargeable lithium batteries provide high energy density for lightweight electric scooters.
examples.zh: 可充電式二次鋰電池具備極高的能量密度比，為當前輕量化電動滑板車提供了充沛續航動能。

examples.en: Airline safety rules prohibit defective or recalled lithium batteries on all passenger flights.
examples.zh: 國際民航飛安規定明令禁止任何經官方公告召回、或外殼有膨脹破損的可疑鋰電池攜帶上機。

words.definition: 免稅的；免關稅地

examples.en: Travelers browse luxury fragrances and Taiwanese pineapple cakes at duty-free shops.
examples.zh: 旅客在登機前悠閒逛著免稅商店，挑選國際奢華香水與台灣在地冠軍鳳梨酥伴手禮。

examples.en: You can buy duty-free spirits and local souvenirs after clearing international departure security.
examples.zh: 順利通過出境安檢查驗後，旅客可以在候機長廊上的免稅精品店購買洋酒名牌包與紀念品。

examples.en: Remember that duty-free items still count toward your arriving destination's customs import limits.
examples.zh: 請注意，在免稅店採買的免稅菸酒與高價精品，入境目的國時依然受到該國入境免稅額度的限制。

words.definition: 機場貴賓室；休息室；悠閒放鬆

examples.en: Business class passengers enjoy complimentary beef noodles and hot showers in the VIP lounge.
examples.zh: 商務艙尊榮貴賓可在機場 VIP 貴賓室內免費大啖現煮熱騰騰牛肉麵並享受舒壓淋浴。

examples.en: Frequent flyers relax inside the airline lounge before boarding long overnight flights.
examples.zh: 高卡哩程常客會員在踏上長途越夜紅眼航班之前，會先在航空公司貴賓室享受愜意的靜謐時光。

examples.en: We sat in the hotel lobby lounge sipping cold sparkling water while waiting for check-in.
examples.zh: 我們坐在五星級飯店寬敞挑高的大廳沙發休息區，一邊品嚐冰鎮氣泡水一邊等候辦理入住手續。

words.definition: 登機門；大門；閘口

examples.en: Boarding gate B7 has announced the final call for passengers on flight CI008.
examples.zh: 位於第二航廈的 B7 登機門廣播正對搭乘華航 CI008 班機的全體旅客進行最後登機呼叫。

examples.en: Check the electronic departure board frequently because your flight departure gate might change.
examples.zh: 請隨時留意航廈內的航班資訊大螢幕，因為班機的登機門位置偶爾可能會臨時調度異動。

examples.en: Passengers gathered near the boarding gate as priority boarding for families with toddlers began.
examples.zh: 當地勤人員宣布攜帶幼童的家庭與輪椅旅客開始優先登機時，旅客們紛紛在登機閘口前依序集合。

words.definition: 登機空橋 (Jet Bridge)

examples.en: Passengers walked through the airbridge and stepped directly into the Boeing 787.
examples.zh: 旅客們依序踏上空調舒適的登機空橋，直接平穩走進波音 787 夢幻客機寬敞的機艙。

examples.en: The climate-controlled airbridge shields travelers from torrential airport rainstorms.
examples.zh: 具備恆溫空調的玻璃全景登機空橋，讓旅客在狂風暴雨中上下飛機依然能保持優雅乾爽。

examples.en: Ground staff aligned the motorized airbridge flush against the aircraft door after parking.
examples.zh: 航機在停機坪滑行到位並關車後，地勤操作員熟練地將電動登機空橋精準對齊機身艙門。

words.definition: 空服人員；服務員；隨從

examples.en: Courteous flight attendants greeted passengers with warm smiles and blankets.
examples.zh: 訓練有素的親切空服員以溫暖熱情的微笑迎接每一位旅客，並主動遞上保暖毛毯。

examples.en: Press the overhead call button if you need assistance from a flight attendant.
examples.zh: 在長途飛行途中若需要任何餐飲服務或協助，只需輕輕按下頭頂上方的空服員呼叫鈴。

examples.en: Flight attendants undergo rigorous emergency evacuation training in simulated cabin mockups.
examples.zh: 全體客艙空服員在正式上線執飛前，皆需在全仿真機艙模擬器中通過嚴格的緊急逃生撤離考核。

words.definition: 座艙長；客艙事務長

examples.en: The chief purser welcomed everyone onboard in English, Mandarin, and Japanese.
examples.zh: 資深座艙長透過機艙廣播以英語、國語及日語三種流利語言向全體機上旅客致以歡迎詞。

examples.en: The purser managed the cabin crew efficiently to ensure smooth inflight dinner service.
examples.zh: 客艙事務長沉著老練地統籌調度全體空服組員，確保長程航班的空中熱食晚宴流程流暢無誤。

examples.en: If you have an urgent medical concern mid-flight, notify the purser immediately.
examples.zh: 若在萬呎高空飛行途中突發急性身體不適，請在第一時間通知座艙長啟動機上醫療處置。

words.definition: 機長駕駛艙；座艙

examples.en: Dual pilots run thorough pre-flight instrument diagnostic checklists inside the cockpit.
examples.zh: 兩位正副駕駛在機長駕駛艙內嚴謹逐一執行起飛前各項航電儀表與氣象雷達自我診斷。

examples.en: High-security armored doors prevent unauthorized entry into the aircraft cockpit during flight.
examples.zh: 飛機駕駛艙配備了高防禦強度的防彈裝甲門鎖，嚴防飛行途中任何未經授權人員擅入駕駛艙。

examples.en: Modern glass cockpit designs replace mechanical dials with intuitive multi-function displays.
examples.zh: 現代新世代客機普遍採用一體化玻璃駕駛艙設計，以高畫質液晶觸控螢幕取代了繁複的傳統機械指針。

words.definition: 客艙；小木屋

examples.en: The spacious wide-body aircraft cabin features dynamic circadian mood lighting.
examples.zh: 寬體雙走道大型客機的客艙內部配備了能隨日夜時間智慧調節情境色彩的舒壓情境燈光。

examples.en: We rented a rustic wooden cabin nestled among the tall pine trees in the mountains.
examples.zh: 我們在連假期間包棟租下了一間隱身於高山參天松樹林間的溫馨質樸原木小木屋度假。

examples.en: The airplane cabin pressure is maintained comfortably at an equivalent altitude of 6,000 feet.
examples.zh: 現代民航客機在萬呎高空巡航時，機艙內部氣壓會始終自動恆定調節於人體舒適的六千英呎等效高度。

words.definition: 走道；走廊（飛機／火車／超市）

examples.en: The passenger preferred an aisle seat for easy access to stretch during long flights.
examples.zh: 在長途跨洋飛行中，這位旅客特別偏好挑選走道座位以便隨時起身活動筋骨去洗手間。

examples.en: The supermarket aisle was stocked with a rich variety of international specialty snacks.
examples.zh: 大型生鮮超市的乾糧零食走道陳列貨架上，琳瑯滿目擺滿了來自各國的特色進口休閒點心。

examples.en: She walked gracefully down the church aisle as the wedding march played softly.
examples.zh: 伴隨著管風琴悠揚浪漫的結婚進行曲樂聲，新娘挽著父親的手臂優雅緩緩走過教堂紅毯中央走道。

words.definition: 繫緊；扣上（安全帶）

examples.en: Please return to your seats and fasten your seat belts during turbulence.
examples.zh: 當安全帶指示燈亮起時，請所有旅客立即回座並確實繫好安全帶以維護自身安全。

examples.en: Fasten the luggage strap securely around your suitcase before checking it at the airport.
examples.zh: 在前往機場櫃檯辦理託運之前，請將十字行李箱固定捆紮帶牢牢繫緊以防箱體在搬運時彈開。

examples.en: Make sure to fasten all buckles on the climbing harness before attempting the rock wall.
examples.zh: 在踏上岩壁攀爬抱石之前，請教練務必逐一檢查確認全身攀岩安全吊帶的各個金屬插扣均已牢牢扣妥。

words.definition: 安全宣導簡報；簡短指示

examples.en: Watch the cabin safety briefing video attentively to locate life vest equipment.
examples.zh: 請全神貫注觀看螢幕播放的機上安全宣導影片，熟記頭頂氧氣面罩與座椅下救生衣位置。

examples.en: The marketing director conducted a strategic morning briefing outlining weekly sales goals.
examples.zh: 行銷總監在每週一上午召集全體業務團隊召開晨間工作簡報，清晰定調本週營收衝刺目標。

examples.en: Before diving into the ocean, the instructor gave a thorough safety briefing on underwater hand signals.
examples.zh: 在背上氣瓶縱身躍入蔚藍大海前，潛水教練在甲板上進行了詳盡的潛水安全宣導簡報與手勢複習。

words.definition: 飛機起飛；起飛升空

examples.en: The twin-engine jet completed a powerful, silky-smooth takeoff into the night sky.
examples.zh: 雙發動機廣體噴射客機在跑道上加速滑行，完成了一次平穩有力、直上雲霄的完美起飛。

examples.en: Remain seated with your seatbelt buckled during taxi, takeoff, and the initial climb.
examples.zh: 在飛機地面滑行、起飛升空及初始爬升階段，全體旅客請務必坐在座位上並繫妥安全帶。

examples.en: Heavy fog delayed aircraft takeoff schedules at northern airports throughout the morning.
examples.zh: 濃密大霧籠罩了跑道視線，導致北部各大國際機場整個上午的所有航班起飛時程皆面臨延誤。

words.definition: 飛機降落；著陸接地

examples.en: Passengers applauded the captain after a gentle touchdown landing in heavy rain.
examples.zh: 在大雨磅礡的惡劣天候中，機長以高超技術穩健接地降落，贏得客艙全體旅客熱烈掌聲。

examples.en: The pilot executed a textbook crosswind landing despite strong coastal gusts.
examples.zh: 面對沿海機場突如其來的強勁側風干擾，正駕駛沉著冷靜展現了教科書級別的完美側風降落。

examples.en: Make sure your window blind is raised during landing so cabin crew can observe external conditions.
examples.zh: 飛機進場降落著陸時請務必主動將座位旁的遮光板拉開，以便機組人員隨時觀察機外突發狀況。

words.definition: 飛行高度；海拔高度

examples.en: The airliner cruised effortlessly at an altitude of 36,000 feet above the Pacific.
examples.zh: 這架洲際客機在太平洋三萬六千英呎的高空巡航高度平穩巡航，窗外雲海波瀾壯闊。

examples.en: Hikers should ascend gradually to adjust to low oxygen levels at high altitude.
examples.zh: 攀登百岳高山時登山隊伍應循序漸進適度紮營適應，以克服高海拔地區空氣稀薄引發的高山反應。

examples.en: The digital altimeter on the pilot's display indicated their altitude was climbing steadily.
examples.zh: 機長駕駛儀表盤上的數位高度表指針穩步上升，顯示飛機正在平穩爬升至預定巡航高度。

words.definition: 晴空亂流；顛簸氣流

examples.en: The aircraft experienced momentary severe clear-air turbulence over the mountains.
examples.zh: 飛機在飛越高聳山脈上空時遭遇了短暫劇烈的晴空亂流顛簸，機長隨即啟動安全廣播。

examples.en: Keep your seatbelt loosely fastened even when the turbulence sign is switched off.
examples.zh: 即使頭頂上的安全帶指示燈已經熄滅，建議在座位上休息時仍全程繫妥安全帶以防突發亂流。

examples.en: Flight attendants paused beverage service immediately due to unexpected sudden turbulence.
examples.zh: 由於遭遇突如其來的強烈顛簸氣流，客艙空服員立即暫停了走道上的推車冷熱飲品派送服務。

words.definition: 機上個人娛樂系統 (IFE)；娛樂

examples.en: Browse hundreds of Hollywood blockbusters on the seatback in-flight entertainment screen.
examples.zh: 透過座椅後方的個人高畫質觸控機上娛樂系統，旅客可隨心點播數百部最新院線強片。

examples.en: The cruise ship offers live Broadway musicals, magic shows, and family entertainment.
examples.zh: 這艘豪華頂級國際郵輪每天在海上劇院上演精彩的百老匯歌舞劇、奇幻魔術秀等豐富娛樂節目。

examples.en: Children stayed cheerful throughout the ten-hour flight thanks to interactive game entertainment.
examples.zh: 多虧了機上娛樂系統內建的益智互動小遊戲，小朋友在長達十小時的飛行旅程中全程專注乖巧。

words.definition: 垂直豎直的；正直誠實的

examples.en: Flight attendants instructed all passengers to return their seatbacks to the full upright position.
examples.zh: 空服員在飛機進場降落前逐一溫柔提醒全體旅客將座椅椅背調整豎直並收起前方腳踏板。

examples.en: Sit upright in your ergonomic office chair to prevent chronic lower back strain.
examples.zh: 在辦公室打電腦伏案辦公時請端正坐姿、保持背部挺直，避免長期彎腰駝背造成腰椎疲勞酸痛。

examples.en: The grandfather clock stood upright against the wall, ticking with antique dignity.
examples.zh: 那座古董落地大座鐘端正筆直地立於客廳轉角牆邊，以沉穩莊重的鐘擺聲記錄著歲月流轉。

words.definition: 飛航模式；離線模式

examples.en: Switch all personal mobile phones and tablets to airplane mode during taxiing.
examples.zh: 當飛機開始在停機坪滑行準備起飛時，請依法將所有智慧手機與平板電腦切換至飛航模式。

examples.en: Turning on airplane mode cuts cellular signals and helps conserve smartphone battery life.
examples.zh: 開啟手機飛航模式能徹底切斷行動網路訊號搜尋，是在電量告急時延長手機待機續航的妙招。

examples.en: You can still use Wi-Fi and Bluetooth while keeping your phone on airplane mode.
examples.zh: 即使手機處在離線飛航模式下，你依然可以單獨開啟機上付費 Wi-Fi 與藍牙耳機連線追劇。

words.definition: 自動查驗通關系統 (e-Gate)

examples.en: Registered Taiwanese citizens clear immigration within ten seconds via smart e-Gates.
examples.zh: 國人返台入境時透過新世代智慧自動查驗通關系統（e-Gate），十秒內即可輕鬆秒速通關。

examples.en: The newly upgraded e-Gate facial recognition cameras match travelers swiftly without masks.
examples.zh: 全新升級的新一代智慧 e-Gate 閘道搭載超高辨識度人臉識別鏡頭，能迅速精準完成人臉身分核驗。

examples.en: Using the automated e-Gate saves travelers from standing in lengthy passport control queues.
examples.zh: 善用自動查驗通關系統，能讓國人徹底免去在傳統人工證照查驗櫃檯前大排長龍的耗時等待。

words.definition: 入出境證照查驗；移民署

examples.en: Present your passport and completed arrival card at the international immigration counter.
examples.zh: 在各國邊境移民署入境查驗檢查櫃檯前，請主動出示個人護照與填寫完整之入境登記卡。

examples.en: The immigration officer asked a few standard questions regarding travel purpose and hotel stay.
examples.zh: 移民署證照查驗官親切詢問了幾項常規入境問題，包含本次造訪的觀光目的與下榻飯店名稱。

examples.en: Clearance through immigration was swift thanks to well-organized queuing lanes.
examples.zh: 得益於機場入境大廳井然有序的分流動線規劃，全體旅客的入境證照查驗流程十分快速順暢。

words.definition: 海關（貨物與行李申報稽查）

examples.en: Go through the Red Channel at customs if you have goods exceeding duty allowances.
examples.zh: 若您隨身攜帶超過免稅限額之高價名品或外幣現鈔，通關時請主動走紅線應申報海關櫃檯。

examples.en: Customs agents randomly scan baggage to detect undeclared foreign currencies or plants.
examples.zh: 海關緝私關員在出關通道前隨機抽驗旅客隨身行李，以查緝未申報之高額外幣或管制生鮮植物。

examples.en: Walk through the Green Channel at customs if you have nothing to declare.
examples.zh: 若您本次入境所攜帶的行李物品皆完全符合免稅規範且無受管制品，可直接步入綠線免申報通道。

words.definition: 海關申報單；鄭重聲明

examples.en: Travelers submit customs declaration forms declaring regulated foreign currencies or tobacco.
examples.zh: 入境旅客依法誠實填寫並繳交海關申報單，主動列明攜帶之受管制外幣現鈔與菸酒數量。

examples.en: Sign the legal declaration at the bottom confirming all entered details are accurate.
examples.zh: 在紙本或電子海關申報單最下方親筆簽名，鄭重確認所有填報的行李物品內容均完全屬實。

examples.en: Failure to make an honest declaration of agricultural products carries heavy monetary fines.
examples.zh: 入境時若未如實申報隨身攜帶的違禁動植物產品，一經查獲將面臨高達數十萬元的巨額罰鍰。

words.definition: 申報；宣布；聲明

examples.en: You must declare all fresh fruits, raw plants, and processed meat snacks.
examples.zh: 依我國邊境檢疫法規，入境時凡攜帶任何生鮮水果、活體植物與加工肉乾皆必須主動申報。

examples.en: The traveler stepped forward to declare two thousand dollars in foreign luxury cosmetics.
examples.zh: 該名旅客主動走向紅線申報台，主動向關員申報其在海外免稅店購置之高價奢華美妝保養品。

examples.en: Always ask the customs officer if you are uncertain whether an item needs to be declared.
examples.zh: 若你對隨身攜帶的土特產或特產零食是否需要海關申報心存疑慮，請在出關前主動詢問海關官員。

words.definition: 動植物防檢疫；隔離檢疫

examples.en: Strict agricultural quarantine measures protect Taiwan from devastating African Swine Fever.
examples.zh: 桃園機場執行滴水不漏的嚴格動植物防檢疫措施，成功將非洲豬瘟等境外重大疫病阻絕於境外。

examples.en: Arriving pets must undergo mandatory rabies quarantine before entering the country freely.
examples.zh: 從海外攜帶貓狗伴侶動物返國時，毛孩必須依規定在指定檢疫舍完成狂犬病抗體隔離檢疫程序。

examples.en: Quarantine officers inspected the imported fruit crates thoroughly for agricultural pests.
examples.zh: 動植物防檢疫人員在貨運航空站開箱仔細抽驗大宗進口水果木箱，嚴查有無夾帶外來害蟲卵塊。

words.definition: 防疫偵測犬（如米格魯米克斯犬）

examples.en: Cute Beagle sniffer dogs patrol baggage claim carousels to detect smuggled meat items.
examples.zh: 可愛又專業的米格魯檢疫偵測犬在行李轉盤間穿梭巡邏，精準嗅出夾帶走私的違禁肉製品。

examples.en: A trained sniffer dog sat down beside a backpack, alerting its handler to prohibited food.
examples.zh: 訓練有素的防疫偵測犬在一只隨身背包旁乖巧坐下，第一時間向領犬員發出有違禁肉品警訊。

examples.en: Airport sniffer dogs possess an incredible sense of smell that outsmarts sealed vacuum packs.
examples.zh: 機場邊境檢疫米格魯偵測犬擁有極其靈敏的嗅覺天賦，連真空密封多層包裝的肉製品也無所遁形。

words.definition: 行李轉盤；旋轉木馬

examples.en: Collect your checked suitcases from baggage carousel 6 according to your flight number.
examples.zh: 請依照機場大螢幕上的航班代號指示，前往六號行李轉盤前耐心等候提領託運行李箱。

examples.en: Luggage emerged slowly onto the moving conveyor carousel after the plane landed.
examples.zh: 飛機落地滑行停妥後不久，全機旅客的託運行李便陸續由行李輸送帶滾上旋轉行李轉盤。

examples.en: The child smiled joyfully while riding the vintage musical carousel in the amusement park.
examples.zh: 小朋友坐在遊樂園裡閃爍著七彩霓虹燈的復古音樂旋轉木馬上，綻放出燦爛幸福的笑容。

words.definition: 行李提領；申領；主張要求

examples.en: Proceed directly to baggage claim after clearing immigration and passport checks.
examples.zh: 在順利通過移民署證照查驗證件後，請依照動線指標前往行李提領大廳提領行李。

examples.en: She filed an official insurance claim after her suitcase was accidentally misplaced.
examples.zh: 在發現自己的託運行李箱不幸遭到航空公司誤送遺失後，她立即向保險公司提出理賠申報。

examples.en: Passengers can claim reimbursement for travel meals if flight delays exceed six hours.
examples.zh: 若因航空公司調度因素導致班機延誤超過六小時以上，旅客有權要求餐飲住宿交通費用補償。

words.definition: 受損毀壞的；摔壞的

examples.en: Report any cracked or severely damaged hard-shell suitcases to the baggage service desk.
examples.zh: 若在轉盤領取行李箱時發現硬殼箱體有嚴重破裂或受損，請立即前往地勤服務處備案申賠。

examples.en: The airline provided a brand-new replacement suitcase for the one that was damaged during transit.
examples.zh: 針對在行李地勤裝卸運送過程中嚴重摔凹摔破的行李箱，航空公司現場直接賠償了一只全新硬殼箱。

examples.en: Inspect your luggage carefully for broken wheels or damaged zippers before leaving the arrivals hall.
examples.zh: 在走出機場入境大廳海關大門前，請務必先仔細檢查個人行李箱輪子是否有摔斷或拉鍊受損。

words.definition: 跨時區時差反應；時差綜合症

examples.en: Morning sunlight and light hydration help ease tired jet lag after long flights.
examples.zh: 抵達目的地後多曬清晨溫暖陽光並多補充純水，有助於迅速調適長途跨洋飛行的時差反應。

examples.en: Traveling eastward across several time zones typically induces worse jet lag than traveling west.
examples.zh: 跨越多個時區向東飛行往往比向西飛行更容易引發更嚴重的生理時鐘錯亂與晝夜時差綜合症。

examples.en: He took a brisk walk in the park to fight off afternoon jet lag exhaustion.
examples.zh: 下飛機當天午後他特地前往附近的綠意公園快步慢跑散步，以克服睡意昏沉的時差疲憊感。

words.definition: 中途轉機停留時間（通常24小時以內）

examples.en: We booked a cheap ticket with a relaxing four-hour layover in Tokyo Narita.
examples.zh: 我們預訂了在東京成田國際機場中途轉機停留四小時的特惠機票，順道在機場大啖拉麵。

examples.en: During an eight-hour layover, many travelers venture out of the airport into the city center.
examples.zh: 面對長達八小時的中途轉機停留空檔，許多旅人會選擇搭乘快線電車進市區展開一場微旅行。

examples.en: The long layover gave her enough time to catch up on work emails inside the quiet lounge.
examples.zh: 充裕的轉機中停等候時間，讓她得以在安靜舒適的機場貴賓室內從容處理完所有緊急商務信件。

words.definition: 轉機過境；大眾運輸

examples.en: Transit passengers must pass through an international transit security checkpoint.
examples.zh: 需在桃園機場轉機續飛歐美的過境轉機旅客，必須依序通過轉機安檢通道重新過安檢。

examples.en: Taipei has an exceptionally clean, reliable, and convenient public rapid transit system.
examples.zh: 台北市擁有享譽全球、乾淨明亮且極為準時便捷的高運量大眾捷運大眾運輸系統。

examples.en: Goods were safely insured against potential damage while in international maritime transit.
examples.zh: 這批出口歐洲的高精密設備貨物在國際遠洋海運航程過境途中，享有全額海上貨物運輸險保障。

words.definition: 銜接的；轉機航班的

examples.en: Ground staff guided rushed travelers to catch their tight 45-minute connecting flight.
examples.zh: 地勤地陪人員在空橋門口貼心舉牌引導時間緊迫的轉機旅客迅速搭上四十五分鐘後的轉機班機。

examples.en: Because our inbound plane was delayed, we missed our connecting flight to London.
examples.zh: 由於前一航段航班起飛延誤，導致我們在轉機樞紐機場遺憾錯過了銜接飛往倫敦的轉機航班。

examples.en: Check your luggage all the way through to your final destination to avoid re-checking on connecting legs.
examples.zh: 辦理登機時請要求地勤將行李直掛至航程最終目的地，免去在中途轉機機場重新提領託運的麻煩。

words.definition: 班機延誤；延期；耽擱

examples.en: Typhoon winds caused a three-hour departure delay for all international evening flights.
examples.zh: 強烈颱風強陣風導致今晚所有從桃園機場起飛的國際航班全面面臨三小時以上的航班延誤。

examples.en: The unexpected technical delay meant we had to spend an extra night in Frankfurt.
examples.zh: 突如其來的機械故障延誤，意味著我們不得不由航空公司安排在法蘭克福過境旅館多待一宿。

examples.en: Heavy morning commuter traffic caused an unavoidable delay for our airport bus.
examples.zh: 早晨上班尖峰時段國道主線車流嚴重回堵壅塞，導致我們搭乘的機場接駁巴士遭遇不可避免的延遲。

words.definition: 班機取消；作廢取消

examples.en: Severe snowstorms forced widespread flight cancellations across northern Japan.
examples.zh: 日本北部遭遇罕見的特大暴風雪襲擊，迫使新千歲機場數十架航班無奈宣布全數取消。

examples.en: The airline offered full refunds or free ticket changes following the sudden route cancellation.
examples.zh: 針對此條突發航線調整取消，航空公司為受影響旅客提供了全額無條件退款或免費改票服務。

examples.en: Travelers should check travel insurance terms regarding compensation for unforeseen flight cancellations.
examples.zh: 出國行前應詳閱海外旅遊不便險之理賠條款，了解針對班機突發取消時可申請的各項衍生補償。

words.definition: 班機延誤理賠補償金；報酬

examples.en: Travel insurance policies provide financial compensation for extended flight delays.
examples.zh: 出國前投保完整的海外旅遊不便險能針對因故延誤四小時以上的航班提供實質定額理賠。

examples.en: Passengers who were bumped from the overbooked flight received generous flight voucher compensation.
examples.zh: 因超賣機位而自願放棄當班座位的旅客，獲得了航空公司現場核發的優厚免費機票兌換券補償。

examples.en: Workers injured on the job are legally entitled to receive workers' disability compensation.
examples.zh: 依據勞工職業災害保險保障法，因公在工作場所受傷的勞工依法享有完整的工傷醫療與殘廢補償。

words.definition: 直飛不中停的；直達的

examples.en: Flying nonstop from Taipei to San Francisco saves four hours of transit exhaustion.
examples.zh: 選擇搭乘台北直飛舊金山的直達不中停航班，能省去長途轉機等候的疲憊並省下四小時。

examples.en: The new nonstop route connects Taichung directly to Tokyo without requiring transfers.
examples.zh: 這條全新開闢的直飛國際新航線，讓中部鄉親能從台中清泉崗機場直達日本東京不必舟車轉乘。

examples.en: Rescue teams worked nonstop for forty-eight hours to clear debris after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 地震發生後，搜救先鋒隊伍不分晝夜連續四十八小時不間斷全力清除倒塌瓦礫搶救生還者。

words.definition: 祝您旅途平安愉快！一路順風！（法語借詞）

examples.en: Friends gathered at the departure gate to bid her a cheerful 'bon voyage!'
examples.zh: 熱情好友們在第二航廈出境大廳齊聚揮手道別，異口同聲祝福她留學旅途一帆風順！

examples.en: We raised our champagne glasses to toast the newlyweds, wishing them bon voyage on their honeymoon.
examples.zh: 大家紛紛高舉手中的香檳酒杯向這對新婚佳人熱情敬酒，由衷祝福他們的蜜月之旅平安浪漫愉快。

examples.en: The captain wished all passengers a safe flight and bon voyage before take-off.
examples.zh: 飛機起飛前機長透過廣播向客艙全體旅客致意，祝福大家擁有一趟平安順遂的美好飛行旅程。
